[Physics] Rope bridges stable at 30 fps (Ape Escape jungle bridge, breakable suspension bridges, the bots' bridge): their own spring simulation keeps 1/600 s sub-steps at any frame rate, as at 60 fps
[Physics] Cloth and inflatables stable at 30 fps (zipper squid, air bubbles and other cloth): the game's cloth engine runs 2 steps of 1/60 s per 30 fps frame, as at 60 fps
[Physics] Jack-in-the-box pads keep Astro on the plate at 30 fps: his extra ground-check reach on the rising plate (0.1 m) scales with the frame time, as the plate moves twice as far per frame
[Crash fix] Havok contact query no longer reads a missing shape (the Havok Worker crash at 0x880472, usually a few seconds after a stutter or level load)
[Crash fix] Havok tree queries stop instead of overflowing their 256-entry node stack (the Physics_ATQT / Havok Worker crash at 0xb5f8c3)

[Fix] Bot rescue plays with the game's own 60 fps timing (rescued bot and controller missing / softlock with delta time): Decouple switches off for the rescue sequence and back on after it, like pressing R1+X (needs Decouple)

[Stability] Delta time step capped at 1/20 s (real speed down to 20 fps): below that the game slows down slightly instead of taking huge steps that make physics and models explode (needs Decouple; enable only one)

[Stability] Delta time step capped at 1/30 s (real speed down to 30 fps, most stable): below that the game slows down slightly instead of taking huge steps that make physics and models explode (needs Decouple; enable only one)
[Memory] Textures: 1080p mip bias (0 instead of the game's -1 for 4K output): slightly softer textures, less texture data used (enable only one mip bias)
[Memory] Textures: low detail mip bias (+1): blurrier textures, least texture data used (enable only one mip bias)
[Memory] 4K textures load at 2K: forces the game's own texture-pool mipmap reduction on (drops the top mip of 4096x4096 textures)
[Memory] Models: lower detail (LOD x0.5): models switch to simpler versions at half the usual distance; less geometry for the GPU and the model streamer (enable only one)
[Memory] Models: lowest detail (LOD x0.25): models switch to simpler versions at a quarter of the distance; small details may pop or vanish sooner (enable only one)
Videos play at real speed below 60 fps (skips video frames to keep up with the clock)
Skip the PlayStation Studios intro video (its 4K video plays at a fraction of real speed in the emulator; the game sees it as already finished)
